task: Fix ADO duplicate attachment — prevent same file from being re-attached to an Azure DevOps work item on repeated updates in the same chat.

technical_risk.label: S
technical_risk.risk_factors: Adds an extra ADO API call (get_work_item with expand=Relations) on every attach invocation; wrapped in try/except fail-open so a fetch failure silently falls back to attaching all files
technical_risk.mitigation: Fail-open design and warning log ensure no blocking regression; extra API call is lightweight and isolated to the preflight guard

key_reasoning.reason: Change is confined to a single method (_process_attachments) in BaseAzureDevOpsFileWorkItemTool; no other components or layers are touched beyond the corresponding test file additions.
Adds one extra ADO API call per attach invocation; risk is mitigated by fail-open try/except — a fetch failure logs a warning and proceeds to attach all files, preserving prior behaviour.
